title: AgentTeamDetailResponse
description: Response for a single Agent Team with input parameter details

data.description: The primary data of the document

id.description: The unique identifier for the resource

meta.description: Non-standard meta information about the resource

AgentTeamDetail.description: Agent Team resource with full input parameter details.

description.description: Human-readable description of the Agent Team. This field is omitted when no objective or description is defined.

triggers.description: The trigger types associated with this Agent Team

active.description: Flag indicating whether the Agent Team's triggers are active or not. Agent Teams that are inactive can still be triggered manually

inputs.description: The input parameters defined for this Agent Team.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when this Agent Team was created

createdBy.description: The id of the user that created this Agent Team

updatedAt.description: The timestamp for the last time this Agent Team was updated

creditsUsed.description: The total amount of AI Credits consumed by this Agent Team over its lifespan

lastRunDate.description: The date of the last successful run of this Agent Team

AgentTeamMeta.description: Metadata information for an Agent Team

name.description: The name of the input parameter. This will be provided in the `name` attribute for the `RunAgentTeamRequest`

required.description: Indicates whether the parameter is required to start the Agent Team run

type.description: The data type of the input parameter. Currently only STRING type parameters are supported

InputParameter.description: Describes an input parameter that is used to start an agent team run
